entries.current_rule: For the T02 digest use root conditions/sample; for the C02 digest use payload.conditions/sample. Select the exact requested IDs in the observed order. Sum both false-return components for each condition; reduction is recovery minus review; fraction denominator is the sum of the two unsupported sample counts, with no rounding.
entries.legacy_scope: Each known base and index order applies to its episode digest. A family handle alone does not identify structure.
